definitions: A brief period of study at a college or university, often vocational or for professional development.
A golf course that is shorter than a standard course, typically consisting of nine holes or having shorter distances between holes.
A swimming pool that is 25 meters or 25 yards in length.
examples: She enrolled in a short course on digital marketing.
They played a round on the local short course.
The competition was held in a short course pool.
